perspectives.label: Powerless observer
perspectives.comment: The Kolmogorov complexity is a fundamental limit on compression, thus a mountain.

perspectives.label: Institutional observer
perspectives.comment: Even institutions cannot overcome the limits of Kolmogorov complexity.

perspectives.label: Analytical observer
perspectives.comment: Analytical observer cannot change the inherent Kolmogorov complexity.

commentary.narrative_context: Kolmogorov Complexity defines the length of the shortest possible description of an object (e.g., a string of data).
